note: The Institute's evidence manifest. Each entry is one feed: where it comes from, how it travels, and when it last moved. The nightly refresh (.github/workflows/refresh.yml) reads this file, pulls what it can over the open internet of a CI runner, and commits only when something changed. A copy is published to apps/platform/public/data/sources.json as the provenance record behind every figure on the site.

sources.name: Key stage 4 performance (Attainment 8, EBacc, basics)
sources.cadence: Provisional mid-October, revised February, final spring
sources.notes: School-level release is a zip download, not yet in the EES API. Pulled by hand via browser when a new vintage lands; next expected movement is the 2025/26 REVISED release, February 2027. Progress 8 has no 2024/25 or 2025/26 cohort; the last published P8 is 2023/24.

sources.name: Pupil attendance in schools (fortnightly)
sources.notes: National, regional and LA-level only — NOT school-level — so it feeds the pulse file (the national weather), never schools.json. apiDataSetId is resolved at run time from the catalogue entry by pull-attendance.mjs.

sources.name: Get Information About Schools (the register itself)
sources.notes: The canonical registry: every school's URN, status, opens, closures and successor URNs. The refresh uses it to catch converted academies (URN changes) and newly opened schools before a performance release names them.

sources.name: School workforce in England (teachers, ratios, vacancies, absence)
sources.cadence: Annual, from the November census (published the following June)
sources.lastVersion: 2025 release (Nov 2025 census; turnover and sickness to 2024/25)
sources.notes: School-level CSVs inside the release zip: size of workforce, pupil-teacher ratios, vacancies, sickness absence. Pulled by hand via browser; the tripwire watches for an API id.

sources.name: Ofsted inspection outcomes (management information)
sources.notes: Published as an ODS/XLSX on gov.uk, no API. Monthly refresh is a hand pull until Ofsted's new report-card data settles into a stable download.

sources.name: Key stage 2 attainment by school
sources.notes: The December 2026 release is the tripwire: when the API dataset version moves, the refresh flags it in the run summary so primary-phase Atlas can be built on fresh data.
